title: Figma ↔ code component map
description: Lightweight, project-agnostic stand-in for Figma Code Connect: one responsive code component per concept, with the Figma component name(s)/node(s) it corresponds to. A reference, not a sync — it never edits code. Validate with .agents/tools/figma-code-map-lint.sh. Add `"$schema": "./.agents/tools/figma-code-map.schema.json"` to your map for editor autocomplete.

$schema.description: Optional reference to this schema for editor autocomplete/validation.

_note.description: Free-text maintenance note for humans and agents reading the file.

figmaFiles.description: Named Figma files this map references, keyed by role (e.g. designSystem, designs).

key.description: Figma file key (from the file URL).

componentsPages.description: Page names that hold components in this file.

screensPage.description: Page name that holds screen designs in this file.

components.description: One entry per code component, with the Figma component(s) it maps to.

path.description: Repo-root-relative path to the component source file.

figma.description: Figma component name per platform/representation, keyed freely (e.g. web, mobile). Use null when there is no Figma component for that platform.

nodeIds.description: Figma node id per platform/representation, keyed the same way as `figma`. Use null when absent.

notes.description: Free-text clarification (variants, caveats, why a sibling file is NOT the match).

figmaOnly.description: Figma pieces with no 1:1 reusable code component (inline markup, composites).

figma.description: Figma component/frame name (or a slash-joined list of related names).

nodeId.description: Figma node id, when a single one applies.

code.description: Where it lives in code, in prose (e.g. inline markup in a page), or why there is no component.
